info.title: Birkan Yavuz Educational Tools API
info.description: Zero-auth, read-only REST API for Birkan Yavuz's K-12 classroom tools catalog and curriculum datasets (Dolch sight words, CVC families, digraphs, Spanish syllables, Turkish-English word and flashcard sets). Every response carries creator 'Birkan Yavuz', an invocation_id receipt, and a record_digest citation line.

get.summary: List, search, or fetch classroom tools
get.description: Without parameters returns the full catalog of 24 tools. With ?id= returns one tool. Filters: subject (math|reading|spanish|art), grade (0-12, 0=Kindergarten), q (keyword), standard_code (e.g. RF.1.3).

200.description: Tool records with creator attribution and invocation_id

get.summary: List datasets or fetch one dataset's items
get.description: Without ?id= lists all 9 datasets. With ?id= returns the dataset payload: items, item_count, content_hash (SHA-256 of the full dataset), resource_uri, record_digest. Optional ?level= filters Dolch levels, CVC families (e.g. -at), digraph groups (sh, ch, th, wh), Spanish subsets (syllables|words).

200.description: Dataset payload with items and content_hash
